ambiguities.reason: The contract specifies 'commencement of the current billing month' but was executed mid-month (2026-02-12), creating ambiguity regarding the specific calendar date.
ambiguities.source_quote: This amendment is effective from the commencement of the current billing month. Executed on: 2026-02-12

commission.source_quote: The Seller shall receive sixty-five percent (65%) of the Net Order Value. The balance is retained by the Platform as its commission.

delivery_fee.source_quote: A delivery fee of Rs. 40.00 per confirmed delivery is payable to the assigned delivery partner.

hold.source_quote: The Seller's share shall become payable upon confirmation of delivery, and shall be settled no earlier than twenty-four (24) hours thereafter.

promotion_funding.source_quote: Discounts shall be funded 100% by the Platform.

provenance.notes: SYNTHETIC contract corpus — not a real merchant agreement.

refund.source_quote: Where a customer refund is issued, the Seller payout for that order shall first be reversed. Commission is refundable.

tax.source_quote: The Platform shall withhold tax at source at one percent (1%) of the commission amount.
